{{Top|leg}}
A '''resonance energizer''' was a weapon component that was installed aboard the [[Sun Crusher]]. The energizer was used to activate the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] payload of [[resonance torpedo]]es. Each [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] passed through the energizer before being launched through the [[resonance projector]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
